name: Speak with Shoni
summary: In Ironforge, Alliance travelers are sent to Stormwind to find Shoni the Shilent, whose unit prepares for Gnomeregan.

sections.title: A Call from Tinkertown
sections.body: After Gnomeregan fell to radiation, surviving gnomes made an exile quarter in Ironforge. Its engineers, tinkers, and strategists keep seeking a way back into their lost home. Tinkertown directs the effort, but the preparations reach beyond Khaz Modan. Now adventurers are sent south to Stormwind, where military gear for fighting underground is being prepared.

sections.title: Subterranean Ambitions
sections.body: In Stormwind's Dwarven District, Shoni the Shilent commands an elite crew trained for underground assault. Her sappers need gyrodrillmatic excavationators to burrow toward the sectors held by troggs. The Deeprun Tram runs beneath the mountains between Ironforge and Stormwind, making the journey to Shoni straightforward.

faq.answer: Shoni the Shilent is a gnomish officer in Stormwind City. She commands an underground assault unit that builds and deploys heavy excavation gear to help retake Gnomeregan.

faq.q: Where can I find Shoni the Shilent?
faq.answer: Shoni is in Stormwind City's Dwarven District, near the blacksmithing trainers and forges, just steps from the Deeprun Tram terminal.

faq.q: How do I get to Stormwind from Ironforge?
faq.answer: The fastest way from Ironforge to Stormwind is the Deeprun Tram on the northeastern side of Tinkertown. It carries travelers beneath the mountains straight to Stormwind's Dwarven District.

faq.q: What does Shoni need help with?
faq.answer: Shoni is outfitting an underground assault crew and needs components for her gyrodrillmatic excavationators. The effort eventually sends adventurers to Westfall and the Deadmines.

faq.q: Is this quest required to get Underground Assault?
faq.answer: No. This is an optional lead. You can go straight to the Dwarven District in Stormwind and speak with Shoni to take up Underground Assault.

faq.q: How does this connect to Gnomeregan?
faq.answer: Gnomish leaders are gathering forces and excavation technology to breach Gnomeregan's defenses. Shoni's team is developing the underground drills needed to break into the contaminated city.

angles.text: As a gnome in Ironforge, you can help reclaim your irradiated home by following Shoni's orders and joining the effort to retake Gnomeregan.
As an engineer, you can see that Shoni's project calls for gyrodrillmatic excavationators, complex gnomish machines built for deep-earth tunneling.
As an Alliance traveler, you can use the Deeprun Tram to move personnel between Ironforge and Stormwind.
